title: mongolstats 0.4.0
text: Experimental clients now expose public data metadata portals alongside PXWeb. bundled data include installed source, copyright, license notice. mn_fuzzy_join_by_name() limits distance calculations one thread, including stringdist larger process-wide default. nso_api_config() inspects server limits; NSO request attempts, retries, redirects, worker processes share scheduler least one second attempts one computer. default retry delay also works stats attached. nso_cache_enable() uses standard R user cache directory, 10 MiB size limit, seven-day expiry default. Set ttl = NULL disable age-based expiry. Existing caches former rappdirs location retained can selected explicitly dir. nso_check_data() reports duplicate observation keys, mixed units geographic levels, unresolved source symbols, absent requested periods without changing values. nso_data(), nso_fetch(), nso_package() retain source provenance, resolved selections, request details, response metadata comments, raw observation symbols. Failed requests preserve available diagnostic context; unsupported multi-content responses raise explicit errors. nso_indicators(), nso_indicator(), nso_indicator_query() provide reviewed GDP resident-population query templates definitions, units, caveats, validation dates. nso_metadata(), nso_metadata_search(), nso_related(), nso_forms(), nso_classification(), nso_metadata_dictionary() expose official definitions collection context, preserving original dates, units, source identifiers, quality flags. nso_portal_data() retrieves explicit public aggregate series, nso_portal_datamarts() discovers available datamarts. Source codes official labels remain distinct; automatic portal--PXWeb equivalence assumed. nso_provenance(), nso_table_info(), nso_citation(), nso_write_manifest(), nso_read_manifest() support inspecting exporting source records. nso_value_status() preserves original observation symbols alongside numeric values. nso_search(live = TRUE) searches beyond bundled catalogue. nso_catalogue_status() describes freshness coverage; rebuilt indexes preserve build metadata require explicit opt-replace catalogue incomplete crawl. Mapping documentation validation use released mongolmaps 0.2.0 later CRAN; GitHub dependency override removed.

title: mongolstats 0.3.0
text: Time dimensions now always returned labels ("2024", "2024-03"), whatever labels . NSO codes periods position, "0" latest period, code Year == "0" changed meaning every time NSO published new period. dimensions still returned codes. labels = "en" "" Year_en-style columns still added. nso_table_periods() now returns tibble code, label, date frequency, oldest period first, instead character vector labels catalogue order (newest first). also finds time dimensions named “Month”, “Quarter” Mongolian, previously missed. nso_package(parallel = TRUE) now runs mirai daemons purrr::in_parallel() instead future.apply; start workers mirai::daemons(). future future.apply longer suggested packages; mirai carrier . sf moved Imports Suggests: deprecated mn_boundaries() needs . Discovery functions (nso_dims(), nso_dim_values(), nso_itms_detail(), nso_sectors(), nso_subsectors(), nso_table_meta(), nso_table_periods()) now raise mongolstats_http_error request fails. Previously failure returned empty result, server outage looked like empty catalogue. Offline mode still returns empty results. pxweb fallback nso_data(), nso_fetch(), nso_package() removed, pxweb longer suggested package. fallback returned data different shape (display-text column names, value column ignored value_name), make network requests offline mode. Failed requests now raise mongolstats_http_error server’s response attached. mn_fuzzy_join_by_name() now errors method = "jw" combined max_distance >= 1. Jaro-Winkler distances lie 0 1, default max_distance = 2 matched every name boundary. Use value max_distance = 0.2. nso_options() now validates values (e.g. mongolstats.lang must "en" "mn", mongolstats.timeout positive number) leaves options unchanged one invalid. warns names mongolstats options. unsupported mongolstats.lang set directly options() now errors instead silently falling back English. nso_table_periods() now errors unknown table id non-string tbl_id, like discovery functions. previously returned character(0), indistinguishable table without time dimension.

title: mongolstats 0.3.0
text: Tables NSO moved another catalogue folder now found automatically: table’s metadata request fails HTTP 400 404, mongolstats looks live catalogue, updates -memory index, tells (class mongolstats_table_moved). Tables published bundled index built found PXWeb search API (class mongolstats_table_located). Previously failed, e.g. GDP table DT_NSO_0500_001V1 NSO’s September 2026 reorganisation. Requests larger server’s limit 1,000,000 cells split several requests results combined. limit set new option mongolstats.max_cells. requests rate-limited data.1212.mn’s published limit 1,000 calls per 100 seconds. New nso_latest_periods() returns labels table’s recent periods, ready selections. New nso_period_date() converts NSO period labels office’s formats ("2024", "2024-03", "2016M3", "2024.03", "2024-II", "2026-07-06") dates. Selections time dimension match periods written formats, nso_period_seq("202401", "202412", = "M") now selects months labelled "2024-01" "2024M1". Previously output matched NSO monthly table. Labels selections match ignoring leading spaces NSO uses indent nested categories, e.g. "GDP, 2015 constant prices" " GDP, 2015 constant prices". nso_search() gains fixed = TRUE literal matching. nso_tables() gains updated column date NSO last updated table, bundled table index rebuilt current catalogue. Table ids now matched case-insensitively, without .px suffix (e.g. "dt_nso_0300_001v2"). mn_join_by_name() mn_fuzzy_join_by_name() now warn (class mongolstats_unmatched_names) naming data rows matched boundary. Previously rows dropped silently, spelling mismatch showed grey polygon map. nso_rebuild_px_index() warns (class mongolstats_incomplete_index) naming catalogue paths whose requests failed, instead silently writing incomplete index, stops immediately offline mode.

title: mongolstats 0.2.0
text: Stricter selection validation: nso_data(), nso_package(), nso_query(), as_px_query() now error selection name match dimension table (previously selection silently ignored full dimension fetched), selections unnamed, two selections target dimension. prevents silently fetching wrong-scope data. title: mongolstats 0.2.0
text: nso_package() longer fails silently: tables fail fetch reported warning naming table, new strict = TRUE argument raises error instead. Previously failed tables dropped without signal. Unified labels vocabulary: nso_data() nso_package() accept "code" alias "none", nso_fetch() nso_dim_values() accept "none" alias "code", either spelling works everywhere. mn_boundaries() session cache: boundary downloads cached memory session (repeated calls, including via mn_join_by_name(), longer re-download multi-megabyte GeoJSON). refresh = TRUE argument bypasses cache. nso_period_seq() input validation: malformed periods (wrong width, month 13, NA, vectors) reversed ranges now error clear message instead silently returning descending sequence failing inside seq.Date().

title: mongolstats 0.2.0
text: Ambiguous table ids now warn: NSO catalogue can reuse one table id different tables different folders (e.g. DT_NSO_2400_015V1 currently names monthly SO2 station table annual air-quality-standards table). mongolstats now warns (class mongolstats_ambiguous_table) names folder picked instead silently resolving arbitrary table. Tables merely cross-listed several folders name resolve silently. embedded PXWeb table index refreshed match current NSO catalogue. Several tables (e.g. cancer incidence DT_NSO_2100_012V1 communicable diseases DT_NSO_2100_035V1) moved different catalogue folders, made lookups stale index return empty results. labels = "mn" labels = "" now actually attach Mongolian labels: label metadata matched data columns display text, two languages share dimension code (English column “Sex” languages use code “Хүйс”), cross-language labels silently never added. Labels now routed code--column map, also fixes English labels mongolstats.lang = "mn". Offline mode longer fires session-cookie GET: .px_session_cookie() bypassed offline gate, nso_data() cached metadata still performed one live request offline mode. Retries longer crash first backoff: default retry backoff formula referenced ..attempt, exist rlang lambdas (argument .x), transient response (429/503) failed “object ‘..attempt’ found” instead retrying. HTTP error verbose messages now include request URL: internal misuse httr2::req_url() getter meant URL always rendered NA dropped messages. Time columns typed "t" handled: PXWeb response flattener kept "d"-typed columns; server typing time column "t" (PXWeb convention; NSO currently uses "d") misaligned row keys column names. nso_fetch() now honors mongolstats.default_labels option, matching nso_data(). nso_itms_search() matches query literally documented (“keyword”); regex metacharacters (e.g. "c++") longer error. nso_search() remains regex search. nso_period_seq() rejects trailing garbage valid year (e.g. "2024abc", "2024-06"); previously year prefix silently used. mn_join_by_name() mn_fuzzy_join_by_name() error clearly name_col column data, instead failing obscure replacement-length error. nso_table_periods() finds time dimension lang = "mn" also matching Mongolian display name. Mixed codes labels: Selection values now mapped element-wise, codes labels can mixed one vector (e.g. Sex = c("Total", "1")). Previously produced “Unknown value: NA” error. Duplicated labels table metadata now produce warning naming ambiguous label. Consistent errors: as_px_query() now raises classed errors nso_data() invalid selections (previously plain stop()). Correct error classes: network failures (DNS, timeout) now signal mongolstats_http_error; previously misclassified mongolstats_offline_error, handlers tell offline mode genuine connection problem.

title: mongolstats 0.2.0
text: Removed unused legacy HTTP layer (.nso_req(), .nso_get(), .nso_post() friends) together now-inert mongolstats.base_url option; requests go PXWeb API base (mongolstats.px_base_url). nso_search() nso_itms_search() share one search helper; PXWeb response flattener factored .px_flatten_response() unit-tested; mongolstats.parallel option now registered reported nso_options(). GeoBoundaries metadata request now uses timeout/retry policy requests. Selection mapping validation consolidated single helper (.px_map_selections()), removing three divergent copies logic. Table resolution now goes .px_resolve_table() everywhere (.px_add_labels(), nso_table_periods(), .px_build_body()), removing remaining inlined index lookups. Integration tests resolve dimension codes live metadata instead assuming positional codes, tests longer break NSO adds new period. Integration endpoint tests now assert concrete shapes longer swallow errors. Added tools/record_fixtures.R record httptest2 fixtures used test-recorded-*.R; tests previously always skipped fixture directories empty. Removed unused globalVariables() declarations, unused lifecycle Suggests entry, stray rendered vignette HTML repository.
